protein-levels.alt: Four panels. Primary: a chain of beads, each an amino acid. Secondary: a coiled alpha helix and a zigzag beta pleated sheet with dashed hydrogen bonds. Tertiary: one chain folded into a compact shape, with nonpolar side chains inside and a disulfide bridge labeled. Quaternary: four folded chains packed together.

amino-acid-peptide.alt: Left: an amino acid, a central carbon bonded to an amino group, a carboxyl group, a hydrogen and an R group. Right: two amino acids joined by a peptide bond between the carbon of one carboxyl group and the nitrogen of the next amino group, with a water molecule released.
